dev.commands.help: Keeper: live-reload a pack source dir into this room: .dev mount <path> | reload | status | unmount (needs TRPG_DEV__SOURCE_ROOT)
dev.commands.denied: Only an authenticated Keeper can manage a dev mount.
dev.commands.disabled: Dev rooms are off on this server — set TRPG_DEV__SOURCE_ROOT to the directory your pack sources live under, then mount a path inside it.
dev.commands.outside_root: That path is not a directory under the configured dev source root ({root}) — mounts are confined there.
dev.commands.no_manifest: That directory has no pack.yaml — point .dev mount at a pack SOURCE tree.
dev.commands.bad_source: The source tree does not parse: {error}
dev.commands.mounted: Dev mount live: {pack} ← {path}. Saves reload this room automatically; .dev unmount stops the sync.
dev.commands.unmounted: Dev mount removed. Imported content stays; the room just stops following the source.
dev.commands.not_mounted: No dev mount in this room — .dev mount <path> starts one.
dev.commands.status: Dev mount: {pack} ← {path} (watching; saves reload this room).
dev.commands.reload_failed: Reload skipped — the source does not parse, nothing was changed: {error}
dev.commands.reload_done: Dev reload: {cards} world card(s), {lorebooks} lorebook(s) → {lore} live lore entries ({removed} stale removed); skills/rulepacks re-scanned, panels pushed. Variable values survive by design.
